d:
North Korean Leader Kim Jong Un has unveiled hundreds of drones at an exhibition. For the first time, Pyongyang has displayed what seems to be a stealth drone bomber along with long-range kamikaze drones that were seen blowing up 'mock ups' of American tanks.
Also on shots, US President Donald Trump and First Lady Melania Trump host Trick-or-Treating children at the White House for Halloween. The Mount Mayon volcano erupts in The Philippines spewing a massive ash cloud and prompting evacuations.
